title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: base interest rate ladder by tier
content:
## Scope

This rate card gives the base annual percentage yield (APY) ladder of every tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts, the method by which each tier applies its ladder, and the smallest end-of-day balance that earns interest.

## Definitions

- **Base APY ladder**: the base APY by end-of-day balance band. Each band is identified by its floor, in USD, and carries an APY in percent. A band runs from its floor up to the next floor; the top band has no upper end.
- **Band method**: "tiered" means the whole balance earns the rate of the highest floor it reaches; "blended" means each slice of balance between floors earns its own band rate.
- **Minimum balance to earn interest**: a day whose end-of-day balance is below this amount earns no interest, in USD.

## Ladders

| Tier | Band floors and base APY | Band method | Minimum balance to earn interest |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | from USD 0.00: 0.05% | tiered | USD 10.00 |
| Statement Savings | from USD 0.00: 0.05%; from USD 10000.00: 0.10% | tiered | USD 10.00 |
| Goal Builder Savings | from USD 0.00: 0.25% | tiered | USD 0.00 |
| Money Market Account | from USD 0.00: 0.10%; from USD 2500.00: 0.50%; from USD 25000.00: 1.00%; from USD 100000.00: 1.50% | tiered | USD 0.00 |
| Premier Money Market | from USD 0.00: 0.25%; from USD 10000.00: 1.25%; from USD 50000.00: 2.00%; from USD 250000.00: 2.50% | blended | USD 0.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | from USD 0.00: 1.50%; from USD 100000.00: 2.75%; from USD 500000.00: 3.25% | blended | USD 0.00 |

## Reading a ladder

- On a **tiered** tier, find the highest floor the end-of-day balance reaches; that band's APY applies to the whole balance. A Money Market Account balance of USD 30000.00 reaches the USD 25000.00 floor, so the whole balance is on the 1.00% band.
- On a **blended** tier, the balance is cut at each floor and each slice carries the APY of the band it lies in. A Premier Money Market balance of USD 12000.00 has a slice of USD 10000.00 in the 0.25% band and a slice of USD 2000.00 in the 1.25% band.
- A balance exactly equal to a floor reaches that floor.

## Points of judgement

**Does a Starter Savings account earn interest on a day it ends with USD 9.99?** No; USD 9.99 is below that tier's USD 10.00 minimum. A day ending at USD 10.00 is not below the minimum and earns interest.

**Which tiers use the blended method?** Premier Money Market and Private Client Money Market. The other four tiers use the tiered method.
